title: Tasty Plan B - Catch and Cook
description:
The mackerel hunt is on but with the water temp up and down its still a bit of a long shot. There has been a lot of good king fish being caught on boats over the last week or so, most casting stick baits and poppers so thought it was a good reason to do the long paddle out and give it a crack while trolling some mackerel rigs. All this was a bit of a non event in the end but I had a Plan B with the trusty snapper still being on the bite, so everything worked out nicely. 


Don't forget to Subscribe + Like + Share if you're into it.
